title: Continue to show a selected refinement when it's over maxValuesPerFacet
body:
This issue is  directly linked to http://stackoverflow.com/questions/36319673/algolia-instantsearch-refinementlist-item-toogle-when-search-for-something-else .
The user want to be able to keep track of already selected refinements in his refinement list, even when its count would imply it's not sent back as a facet value in the response.

Here the refinement is selected:
![selected](http://i.stack.imgur.com/uUbhu.png)

But if your change the query, it disappears:
![selected but gone](http://i.stack.imgur.com/6SfZ4.png)

As I've said in the answer, this is partly solved by _currentRefinedValues_. Do we want to also expose an option on faceting widgets?

comments.body:
Hi sorry @Jerskouille I ignored not on purpose this issue. Yes this is a good idea because this would allow people to unselect facet values from the same list they selected them when the facet values are no more relevant.

This need an API proposal
Seems right but I still have trouble understanding how it really work :D
The default sort has changed in v2.
Now that in v2, the default behaviour will keep the refined facet values on top, I don't think we need a guide. WDYT @vvo ?

Can you still override it to achieve a Amazon-like star widget?
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5095856/27032920-48e5e078-4f77-11e7-96b7-322f3c50a134.png)

> Now that in v2, the default behaviour will keep the refined facet values on top

> The user want to be able to keep track of already selected refinements in his refinement list, even when its count would imply it's not sent back as a facet value in the response.

I am unsure this we are talking about the same issue here. ?

I guess if they're always on top, this solves my issue of the facet disappearing when it goes after the list.
The only case I can think of where you wouldn't want the refined first will be cases where the amount of facets are fixed (star widget being the best example to my mind).

> I am unsure this we are talking about the same issue here. ?

Yes the values are consolidated in the helper. The problem is displaying those values, when there is a soft limit on the number of facet displayed. We might retrieve 20 (show more), only display 10 (limit 10) and have 3 that are selected but have a 0 count.

I'm not sure I get the star widget problem. Can you give an example @Jerskouille ?

The screenshot I gave in my previous to last post. An amazon like widget, when you click 3-stars, you don't want it above every other option, you want it right between 2 and 4 stars. Hence my first question: are we still able to override the sorting strategy ? :)
There is no sorting strategy applied on stars https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/examples/media/?q=tomato&idx=movies&p=0&is_v=2
